question: As of October 2020, who among the following is an Indian of the International Court of Justice?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dalveer Bhandari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dalveer Bhandari has been serving as a Judge at the International Court of Justice since April 27, 2012.
 
• He was** re-elected to the ICJ in November 2017 for a nine-year term**.
 
• Bhandari has previously served as a Judge of the Supreme Court of India.
 
• He is known for his contributions to international law and human rights.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Court of Justice (ICJ)**

 
 
• The ICJ is the principal judicial organ of the United Nations.
 
• It was established in June 1945 by the Charter of the United Nations and began work in April 1946.
 
• The seat of the Court is at the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands.
 
• The ICJ settles legal disputes between states and gives advisory opinions on international legal issues referred to it by the UN.
 
• The Court is composed of 15 judges elected to nine-year terms by the UN General Assembly and the Security Council.
 
 
 
• **Judicial Contributions of Dalveer Bhandari**
 
 
• He has made significant contributions to the fields of human rights and international law.
 
• His judgments have been referenced in several international legal contexts.
 
• Bhandari has been a part of several landmark cases at the ICJ, including cases involving maritime disputes and international boundary issues.
 
 
 
• **ICJ's Role in International Law**
 
 
• The ICJ plays a crucial role in maintaining international peace and security by adjudicating disputes between nations.
 
• It ensures the application of international law and provides a legal framework for the conduct of states.
 
• The advisory opinions of the ICJ, though non-binding, carry significant weight in the international legal community.
